whenToUse: Checking delivery status after an order.
An outside tracking number is shown too.
whenNotToUse: Work where a progress percentage matters (use a progress bar).
A single status line without steps (use a status badge).
Showing the live location on a map.
accessibility: The steps are an ol, with aria-current="step" on the current one.
Screen reader text adds that it's the current step.
Copying the tracking number is a button.
